title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A confident female warrior with purple hair stands in a dynamic combat pose, gripping a massive purple warhammer with both hands. She wears a white and purple cropped armored top, baggy white pants with purple accents, and matching armored boots and gauntlets.
prompt: A fierce young woman with short dark purple hair in a dynamic action stance, wielding a very large purple warhammer with crackled texture and white handle. She wears a white and purple cropped fantasy armor top exposing her midriff, baggy white pants with purple straps and belts, purple armored gauntlets and greaves, and white boots. Strong contrapposto pose against a solid dark gray background, clean comic book style with bold outlines and vibrant colors.
